results.instruction: Type into 'Search to find a specific dataset...'
Click on 'National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration'
Press the 'U.S. Department of Commerce' button
Enter a search query into 'Search NOAA sites'
Choose 'National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration home'
Type into 'Search Open Data for things like 311, Buildings, Trees'
Select 'sign up for the NYC Open Data mailing list'
Select 'Watch recordings from 2026 and past Open Data Weeks'
Search using 'Enter search term(s), Ligand ID or sequence'
